svg.title: Only the all-blue requests take the fast path
svg.desc: A dense top-to-bottom Sankey-style diagram has no displayed counts or percentages. Endpoint, routing strategy, and provider rows each say choose one. Callbacks form a single grouped choose-many stage with checkboxes: S3 logs and spend logging are highlighted, while Prometheus, Langfuse, and Datadog appear as other options. A request can enable spend logging and S3 together. Ribbons pass through the callback group rather than split into mutually exclusive callback options. Blue ribbons track only requests that meet all fast-path conditions; gray ribbons show requests that use Python, including those passing through some eligible choices. Weights remain illustrative, with larger Messages and simple-shuffle streams. Native Anthropic providers are interspersed with translated APIs.

g.text: All enabled callbacks must be supported for the fast path
A request can enable spend logging and S3 logs together.
